passage:
A library book lost its cover, so many students ignored it. Without the colorful picture, it looked old and boring.
One day, a student opened it by chance and found an exciting adventure story. She told her friends, and soon the book was borrowed again and again.
The librarian asked students to design a new cover for it. Many joined. The winning cover showed a boat under a stormy sky.
After the new cover was added, even more students borrowed the book.
The story inside had not changed, but people needed help noticing it.
A good cover cannot make a bad book good, but a missing cover can hide a good book from busy eyes.

glossary.translation: 有暴風雨的；風雨交加的
